# Alumni AI — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Overview for LLMs

> Canonical machine-readable description of Alumni AI, its capabilities, architecture, and creators.

---

## 1. Product Summary
- **Title**: Alumni AI
- **Live Deployment**: https://alumni-ai-teamalum.vercel.app/
- **Organization**: Team Alum (https://team-alum.vercel.app)
- **Principal Architect**: Sudarshan Sunil Hadmode (Founder, AI Engineer, Pune, India)
- **Co-Founder**: Soham Arvind Takale (Prompt Engineer, AI Behavior Designer)
- **Category**: Educational AI, Developer Tools, Autonomous Research Assistant
- **Operating Platforms**: Web Browser, Progressive Web App (PWA on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux)

---

## 2. Key Features
- **Artifact Studio**: Enables users to generate and immediately run full-stack single-page applications, interactive calculators, charts, games, and web prototypes in an isolated iframe.
- **Autonomous Web Research**: Fetches and aggregates real-time sources using headless Chrome automation with inline source citations.
- **Academic & Coding Intelligence**: Specialized in computer science, STEM subjects, prompt optimization, and technical troubleshooting.
- **Privacy & Security**: Operates with strict client-boundary security; no private user keys are exposed or retained.

---
